about: The collecta of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: O God, Who knowest that amid such great dangers we cannot stand because of human frailty, grant us health of mind and body, that with Thy help we may overcome those things which we suffer for our sins. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
